headline: A heavy earnings week: Robinhood and SoFi (Tue), Microsoft, Alphabet, Oracle's Investor Day and the Fed (Wed), then Amazon, Intel and Sandisk (Thu). Apple hit a new 52-week high on Duo launch day and passed Nvidia in value, while Nvidia, Alphabet and Sandisk kept breaking lower
calendar: Week calendar. Tue Oct 27: SoFi (about 7am ET), Robinhood (5pm ET) and SK Hynix. Wed Oct 28: Fed decision, Microsoft (after close), Alphabet, Oracle Investor Day (10:55am CT) and Apple's Los Angeles event. Thu Oct 29: Amazon, Intel and Sandisk (4:30pm ET). Mon Nov 2: Apple (2pm PT) and Palantir. Tue Nov 3: AMD (2pm PT), Astera (4:30pm ET), Lam's annual meeting and Snowflake Expedition (Nov 3–5). Wed Nov 4: Arm and Qualcomm. Thu Nov 5: MP Materials. Pending, no date: Judge Noreika's royalty ruling in Qualcomm v. Arm. Chart picture: Friday was calmer after Thursday's rout. CRWD +8.3% and OKTA +5.8% led a cybersecurity bounce, and SNOW rose 3.7%. AAPL set a new 52-week high of $351.73 intraday. NVDA, GOOG and SNDK made further closes below their 20-day lows, and META, INTC and SNDK are sitting on their 200-day averages. LRCX (RSI 6), ARM (11), INTC (16), SNDK (17), ALAB and NVDA (20–22) and GOOG, META and MP (24) are the most oversold, and IBM (86) and AAPL (72) are the most extended.
